messages.text:
The reference’s successful search output contains elapsed time, so byte-for-byte equality is only stable after treating that timing line as inherently dynamic; the reference binary itself will not repeat it exactly.

I’m still implementing the real CLI/search behavior, but the verifier should compare the stable observable contract and separately require the same status/error channels.
